create_coco_detection_dataset: create a CocoDetection dataset from an image folder and COCO annotation JSON file with transforms
convert_coco_poly_to_mask: convert COCO polygon segmentations into binary mask tensors given height and width dimensions
filter_and_remap_coco_categories: filter COCO annotations to a subset of category IDs and optionally remap category indices
convert_to_coco_api: convert a PyTorch dataset with boxes, labels, and masks into a pycocotools COCO API object
get_coco_dataset: get a COCO detection or keypoint dataset for train or val splits with polygon-to-mask transforms applied
